fusions.name: Downpour Run
fusions.desc: Lets loose 5 spread-out streaks, each dealing 3 damage and leaving the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds, cold and lightning biting deeper and fire less. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Slick Heel
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Pavement
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Puddle Stride
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
